name: Nutech Global Limited
about: Nutech Global Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells cotton and synthetic fabrics in India. It operates through Textile and Solar Power segments. The company offers suiting, shirting, ready-made garments, dress materials for uniforms, and home furnishings, as well as COVID-19 products. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Nutech Spinning Ltd and changed its name to Nutech Global Limited in April 2002. Nutech Global Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Bhilwara, India.
